en_title: Skydance Games Confirms Layoffs Following Warner Bros.-Paramount Merger
cn_title: Skydance Games确认在Warner Bros.与Paramount合并后裁员
opus_summary: Skydance Games证实，继上月华纳兄弟与派拉蒙合并后，公司正在重组并缩减部分项目，导致一些岗位受到影响。Insider Gaming报道称至少30名开发人员受到裁员影响，实际人数可能更高。

paragraphs.en: Skydance Games has laid off staff following last month's Warner Bros-Paramount merger.
paragraphs.cn: 上个月Warner Bros.与Paramount合并后，Skydance Games裁减了员工。

paragraphs.en: Rumblings of a restructuring started when employees from the recently established Paramount Games Studio reported they had been let go earlier today. Skydance confirmed the layoffs in a statement shared with Variety .
paragraphs.cn: 今天早些时候，新近成立的Paramount Games Studio的员工表示自己已被解雇，重组的传闻由此开始流传。Skydance在一份向《综艺》提供的声明中证实了裁员。

paragraphs.en: "As part of our ongoing efforts to position Skydance Games for long-term growth and success, we are implementing reorganization and operational shifts across a few areas of our business," a Skydance spokesperson said. "We have stepped back and taken some time to consider where we are investing our efforts and have made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects.
paragraphs.cn: Skydance的一位发言人表示：「作为我们持续努力为Skydance Games的长期增长和成功做好布局的一部分，我们正在对几个业务领域进行重组和运营调整。我们暂时退后一步，花时间考虑了我们投入精力的方向，并做出了缩减部分项目规模的艰难决定。

paragraphs.en: "As a result, there are roles impacted. This is not a reflection of the talent, dedication, or creativity of those affected and we are grateful for their contributions. We are committed to approaching the process with transparency, care and respect for those who are leaving the company."
paragraphs.cn: 「因此，一些职位受到了影响。这并不反映受影响人员的才能、奉献精神或创造力，我们感谢他们做出的贡献。我们致力于以透明、关怀和尊重离职人员的方式处理这一过程。」

paragraphs.en: Paramount Games – which encompasses gaming studios like Skydance Interactive, Skydance New Media, and other Paramount and Skydance entities – was announced this past June. During an interview with IGN at the time , senior vice president, head of creative and production Shawn Kittelsen detailed what was then described as a renewed push into AAA gaming. This included the announcement of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin , as well as games based on projects like Yellowstone, Tulsa King, and Lioness .
paragraphs.cn: Paramount Games于今年6月公布，旗下包括Skydance Interactive、Skydance New Media等游戏工作室，以及Paramount和Skydance的其他实体。在当时接受IGN采访时，高级副总裁兼创意和制作主管Shawn Kittelsen详细介绍了这一当时被称为重新进军AAA游戏领域的举措。其中包括公布《忍者神龟：最后的浪人》，以及根据《黄石》《塔尔萨之王》和《特别行动：母狮》等作品改编的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Now, many of the people who would have been or were working on projects in its upcoming slate have been laid off. Writer Mallory Dobry , senior concept artist Ameorry Luo , lead VFX artist Michael Parsons , and associate design director David Ballard were just a few of the names impacted by the move, with each taking to LinkedIn to update their work status.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，许多原本将参与或正在参与其即将推出的项目的人员已被裁掉。编剧Mallory Dobry、高级概念美术师Ameorry Luo、首席视觉特效美术师迈克尔Parsons和副设计总监David Ballard只是受到此举影响的部分人员，他们各自在LinkedIn上更新了自己的工作状态。

paragraphs.en: "Skydance just lost a ton of great talent yesterday," lead engineer David Vera said . "I was not affected this time, but so many passionate, hard-working, talented individuals are now competing with thousands of others trying to get their next gig. In this tumultuous climate, it's hard to find great talent and collaborators to help build your next team and game. The Skydance crew wasn't let go because of performance or problematic behaviors. These are all extremely worthy folks who were pushing themselves to the limit to try to make something they could all be proud of."
paragraphs.cn: 首席工程师David Vera说：「Skydance昨天刚刚失去了大量优秀人才。我这次没有受到影响，但这么多充满热情、勤奋且有才华的人，现在正与成千上万的其他人竞争，试图找到下一份工作。在这种动荡的环境下，很难找到优秀人才和合作者，帮助组建下一个团队、打造下一款游戏。Skydance的这些员工被解雇并不是因为表现或行为问题。他们都是非常优秀的人，一直在竭尽全力，试图做出让所有人都能引以为傲的东西。」

paragraphs.en: Insider Gaming reported that at least 30 developers were affected by Skydance layoffs, adding that "it's believed that the real number is higher." The Skydance games layoffs arrive in a post-Warner Bros.-Paramount merger world. The two entertainment giants were given the go-ahead to join under one Skydance banner last month. We've felt the ramifications of that deal in more ways than one today, as DC Studios just announced that James Gunn and Peter Safran would be stepping down as co-chairmen of the company , effective December 1.
paragraphs.cn: Insider Gaming报道称，至少有30名开发人员受到Skydance裁员的影响，并补充说「据信实际人数更高」。Skydance游戏业务的裁员发生在Warner Bros.与Paramount合并之后。上个月，这两家娱乐巨头获准合并至Skydance旗下。今天，我们从不止一个方面感受到了这笔交易的影响：DC Studios刚刚宣布，詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰将卸任公司联合主席，12月1日生效。
